description: A very special and happy birthday to Rust!

description: A Chainsaw. Very effective at cutting trees in addition to soft fleshy objects. Requires Low Grade Fuel to run.

description: Primitive tool used for harvesting Stone, Metal ore and Sulfur ore.

Transform your base from a rusty shack to a cozy hideout! This tool lets you apply wallpaper on walls, floors and ceilings. A nice touch of style - until the next raid, at least.

Press [+attack2] to select your skin.

description: A shotgun trap triggered by movement, place near doorways and load with handmade shells.
